user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a garden shed. A small garden shed with four walls, a single hinged door on the front, a small window, and a pitched gable roof with slight eaves overhang. Wooden plank siding, meter scale, origin at the front-left corner. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
